Review this Python code and identify issues with correctness, error handling, and performance:

def read_sensor_data(file_path):
    data = []
    f = open(file_path)
    lines = f.readlines()
    for i in range(0, len(lines)):
        parts = lines[i].split(',')
        data.append({'timestamp': parts[0], 'value': float(parts[1])})
    return data

This function is supposed to project 3D LiDAR points onto a 2D camera image plane but produces incorrect results. Find and fix the bug:

def project_lidar_to_image(points_3d, K, R, t):
    points_cam = R @ points_3d.T + t
    points_img = K @ points_cam
    u = points_img[0] / points_img[2]
    v = points_img[1] / points_img[2]
    mask = points_3d[:, 2] > 0
    return u[mask], v[mask]
